Lower bound (inclusive) for an event's e: Lower bound (inclusive) for an event's end time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"). Required to bound the cross-calendar scan.
Upper bound (exclusive) for an event's s: Upper bound (exclusive) for an event's start time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z"). Required to bound the cross-calendar scan.
When enabled, recurring events are expan: When enabled, recurring events are expanded into their individual instances instead of returning the underlying recurring event.
The calendars whose schedules must all b: The calendars whose schedules must all be free. A slot is returned only when it is open on every selected calendar.
Start of the search window, as an absolu: Start of the search window, as an absolute ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-01T09:00:00Z"). Prefer absolute times over relative ones.
End of the search window, as an absolute: End of the search window, as an absolute ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-05T18:00:00Z").
Discard any open slot shorter than this: Discard any open slot shorter than this many minutes. Leave empty to return every open slot regardless of length.
If set together with Working Hours End,: If set together with Working Hours End, each day's open slots are clipped to this hour range, interpreted in UTC (not the calendar's local time zone). Example: 9 for 09:00 UTC. Leave both unset to return slots across the full window.
Upper bound of the daily working-hours w: Upper bound of the daily working-hours window. Example: 17 for 5 PM. Ignored unless Working Hours Start is also set.

Optional upper bound (exclusive) for an: Optional upper bound (exclusive) for an instance's start time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp with offset (e.g. "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z").
